mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS posts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS comments
SELECT CAST(u.created_at AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users u WHERE u.created_at >= #{from} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY CAST(u.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT CAST(p.created_at AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM posts p WHERE p.created_at >= #{from} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY CAST(p.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT p.id, p.title, b.name AS board_name, u.nickname AS author_nickname, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN boards b ON b.id = p.board_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

sql.if: AND (LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(p.content_text) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%')))

SELECT p.id, p.title, b.slug AS board_slug, b.name AS board_name, u.nickname AS author_nickname, p.status, CASE WHEN p.deleted_at IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS deleted, p.view_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN boards b ON b.id = p.board_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{condition.limit} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, p.title AS post_title, c.content, u.nickname AS author_nickname, c.status, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS deleted, c.created_at FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON p.id = c.post_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{condition.limit} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE 1 = 1
